posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
So, just spitballing here:

Legacy: Doing his best impression of a cool pose; being a dad, he's way off the mark and a decade or so behind. Felicia is behind the camera, sighing in exasperation.

Tachyon: Thought she could sneak in a quick snack between Felicia hitting the button and the shutter closing but mistimed it

Bunker: Not actually there, he just put the suit in the frame and went to take care of some other business.

Wraith: Actually doing a cool pose because, like all brooding, night-stalking, roof-lurking heroes, she knows how to work it.

AZ: Has no idea how normal people are supposed to pose for pictures, so he's just standing there and hoping the visor hides his goggle-eyed awkwardness.
